Workspace, session and history ownership
|
|-- [O] CanvasWorkspace manages open document lifetimes
|   |-- Creates, subscribes to and disposes CanvasSessions
|   |-- drafts[documentId]: CanvasDraft
|   |   |-- Identity: representationId / name / revisionId
|   |   |-- Save baseline: savedName / savedScene / savedEdges
|   |   |-- Presentation: busy / hidden / viewport / focusBox
|   |   `-- session: CanvasSession
|   |       |-- [O] Retains MappingDocumentController
|   |       |-- [M] Exposes coordinated session stores
|   |       |   |-- document
|   |       |   |-- presentation / selection
|   |       |   `-- controls / geometry / status
|   |       `-- [C] onCommit() -> workspace persistence notification
|   `-- controllers[documentId]
|       `-- [D] Index of controllers retained by sessions
|
|-- [O] MappingDocumentController retains editing state
|   |-- MappingGridDocument: semantic document
|   |-- MappingCanvasState: interaction and presentation
|   |   `-- MappingControls
|   |       |-- activeBoxId / selectionFocusId / activeThreadId
|   |       `-- surfaces[ownerId]: SelectionSurfaceState
|   `-- Retains CanvasEditingContext as a history attachment
|       `-- [O] Service owns context lifetime
|
|-- [O] CanvasHistoryService owns contexts and histories
|   |-- Retained checkpoints and diagram revision bindings
|   |-- Baseline / current head / undo and redo paths
|   |-- [D] document + view + correspondence -> checkpoint
|   |   `-- Layout bound to exact diagram revisions
|   |-- [C] Controller undo / redo / reset -> service navigation
|   |   `-- [D] context + target checkpoint -> restored state
|   `-- [C] forkHistory -> forkContext
|       `-- [O] Distinct context retains diagram revision IDs
|
`-- [O] DiagramService is sole content-revision writer
    |-- [M] Exposes create / revise / resolve / generate
    `-- [D] content + source evidence + base revision
        `-- Immutable new revision + proven node correspondence
